name: Golden Canyon and Gower Gulch
why: Up a canyon of golden badlands to the foot of Manly Beacon and back down the dry wash of Gower Gulch, the colours changing all the way.
book: No permit. Park entrance fee. Rangers advise against hiking after 10:00 in summer.
water: None: carry 2-3 litres even in winter.
dangers: Deadly heat from May to September: people die here every year.
Flash floods in the canyons after rain.
A short drop over a dry fall at the bottom of Gower Gulch.

points.name: Golden Canyon trailhead
points.note: A parking area on Badwater Road, 3 km south of Furnace Creek.

points.name: Red Cathedral junction
points.note: A side path climbs to the red walls of Red Cathedral.

points.name: Manly Beacon
